document.abstract: This standard specifies the location and size of the 8-mm type S printed picture areas for negative and intermediate optical reduction printing on 35-mm motion-picture film perforated 2R-1664 in row positions 1 and 0 and for print films derived by optical or contact printing on 35-mm film perforated 5R-1667 in row positions 1, 3, 5, 7, and 0.
